command: br=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$br" = main ] || exit 0; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- .claude/memory)" ]; then git add .claude/memory && git commit -q -m 'memory: auto-save' -- .claude/memory || exit 0; fi; git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ "$(git rev-list --count main..origin/main)" -gt 0 ] && { git rebase -q --autostash origin/main 2>/dev/null || { git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null; exit 0; }; }; [ "$(git rev-list --count origin/main..main)" -gt 0 ] && git push -q origin main 2>/dev/null; exit 0
